_meta.description: Heart event #1 for npc_michelle: The Herb Basket

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Michelle drops her herb basket. Dried flowers scatter everywhere]

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Oh no! Oh no no no — my calendula!

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Th-thank you! I'm so clumsy. I'm sorry for the trouble.

options.text: No trouble at all. These smell amazing.
You carry too much. Let me help you to the clinic.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: You... you really don't have to. But thank you.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: The calendula is for burn salve. For the workshop injuries.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I-I mean, not that YOU get burned. I just... prepare for everything.
